clue.text: Capital boom develops after depression

indicators.note: after puts the shuffled boom behind the depression word in the answer

parts.note: a col is a dip or pass between two mountain peaks

indicators.note: develops suggests the letters of boom growing into a new shape

explanation.surface: A capital city enjoys an economic boom following a slump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Depression' looks economic but is a dip between mountains; 'develops' shuffles the boom, and 'after' puts the result behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Colombo is the commercial capital of Sri Lanka, a city named for the clue's opening word.

clue.text: An alternative to a politician speechifying

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: The other choice to a politician making speeches.
explanation.definitionFit: Oratory is the art of public speaking, which is speechifying.

clue.text: Nigerian tribesmen hold up the French with daggers drawn

annotationWithheld.clue: Nigerian tribesmen hold up the French with daggers drawn

clue.text: Animal that follows the ragtag in a rabble

definitions.meaning: a cat, dog or horse with a docked or short tail

definitions.text: that follows the ragtag in a rabble
definitions.meaning: the old phrase ragtag and its partner word together mean the common riffraff

explanation.definitionFit: A short-tailed creature, and the second half of an old phrase meaning riffraff.

clue.text: It's glee, shown strangely by a mournful poet

indicators.note: shown strangely says the letters of the two words appear in an odd new order

explanation.surface: A mournful poet oddly displays happiness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shown strangely' rearranges the seven letters ITSGLEE.
explanation.definitionFit: An elegist writes elegies, poems of mourning for the dead.

clue.text: Does not arise from falsehood and evil

parts.note: a lie is a falsehood
sin means evil or wrongdoing

explanation.surface: Something does not spring from untruth and wickedness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arise' looks abstract but means get out of bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who stays in bed late rather than getting up is said to do this.

clue.text: Soldier imprisons a licentious Italian union leader

indicators.note: imprisons says the soldier word encloses the other pieces

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
ribald means bawdy or licentious

explanation.surface: A soldier locks up a lewd Italian trade unionist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'union leader' suggests a trade union, but the union is Italian unification.
explanation.definitionFit: Garibaldi led the military campaign that unified Italy in the nineteenth century.

clue.text: Charge for keeping silver in reserve

indicators.note: keeping says the reserve word holds the silver inside it

parts.note: a store is a reserve kept for later
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A fee for holding silver in reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Storage is the fee charged for keeping goods in a warehouse.

clue.text: One well-liked at work has plenty of backing

definitions.text: One well-liked at work has plenty of backing

parts.words: One well-liked at work has plenty of backing
parts.note: read as an office favourite with supporters, but backing is betting money on the leading runner

explanation.surface: A popular colleague enjoys lots of support.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner strongly expected to win attracts heavy betting; a firm also means a business.

clue.text: Michael's first card is a club

indicators.note: first asks for only the opening letter of the name Michael

parts.note: an ace is a playing card

explanation.surface: Michael plays his first card, a club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'card' and 'club' tempt toward the card suit, but the club is a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A mace is a heavy ceremonial or fighting club with a spiked head.

clue.text: Man of the match

parts.note: reads as a sporting award, but a match here is a marriage and the man is one of its two partners

explanation.surface: The best player of the game.
explanation.definitionFit: At a wedding, the husband-to-be is the male partner in the marriage match.

clue.text: Concerned with taxes, she showed spirit, keen to make a return

parts.note: go means spirit or energy, as in full of go

indicators.note: to make a return asks for the word for keen to be written backwards

parts.note: avid means keen or eager

explanation.surface: A tax protester showed spirit and was keen to file a tax return.
explanation.walkthrough: Lady Godiva rode naked through Coventry to get her husband to cut taxes, so 'showed' means she showed herself; 'return' borrows the tax sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Legend says the noblewoman rode unclothed through Coventry in protest at her husband's heavy levies.

clue.text: Postal packet going overseas

parts.note: reads as a parcel sent abroad, but a packet is also a packet boat, a ship carrying letters

explanation.surface: A parcel sent abroad by post.
explanation.definitionFit: A packet boat was a vessel carrying mail on a regular sea route.

clue.text: Bikini, say, grabbed by nurse as religious leader appears

indicators.note: grabbed by says the nurse word holds the Bikini word inside it

parts.note: an ayah is a nanny or nursemaid in India
Bikini is a Pacific atoll, given as an example

explanation.surface: A nurse seizes a swimsuit just as a cleric turns up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bikini' is not swimwear but the Pacific atoll used for nuclear tests; 'say' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: An ayatollah is a senior Shia Muslim cleric in Iran.

clue.text: Place of refreshment for Great Dane off the leash

indicators.note: off the leash suggests the dog's letters running loose and free

explanation.surface: A big dog is let loose in a cafe garden.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea garden is an outdoor space serving tea and light food.

clue.text: Fast ships

definitions.meaning: as an adjective the word means swift or nimble
a group of naval vessels sailing under one command

explanation.definitionFit: The word means swift of foot and also a navy's assembled vessels.

clue.text: Mackerel bait?

parts.note: alludes to the saying about risking a small fish to catch a mackerel, a small outlay for a big gain

explanation.surface: What an angler puts on the hook for mackerel.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb speaks of using this small fish to catch a mackerel, a little risk for a large return.

clue.text: Place to drink in speed boat

indicators.note: in says the drinking place goes inside the speed word

parts.note: pace means speed
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A bar on a speedboat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'speed boat' reads as one thing; split it into 'speed' (PACE) and 'boat' (the definition).
explanation.definitionFit: A pinnace is a small boat carried aboard a larger ship.

clue.text: Called round on one occasion in vain

indicators.note: round says the word for called goes around the other piece

parts.note: cited means called, as a witness is cited to court
once means on one occasion

explanation.surface: Someone paid a visit once, to no avail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in vain' reads as futile, but 'in' is a link and 'vain' means proud.
explanation.definitionFit: Conceited and vain both describe excessive pride in oneself.

clue.text: Anger over a disease

indicators.note: over in a down clue places the anger word above the single letter

parts.note: choler is an old word for anger

explanation.surface: Fury about an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Cholera is an acute intestinal infection spread by dirty water.

clue.text: Covered a trial in the final days

indicators.note: in says the trial word sits inside the other piece

parts.note: the end means the final days
a case is a trial in court

explanation.surface: A court hearing was reported in the closing days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Covered' looks like news reporting but means enclosed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something encased is enclosed or covered over completely.

clue.text: Advocates breaking into stolen capital

indicators.note: breaking into says the advocates word enters the stolen word

parts.note: hot is slang for stolen goods
the bar is the body of barristers or advocates

explanation.surface: Lawyers burgle a capital that was looted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money but is a state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Hobart is the capital city of the Australian state of Tasmania.

clue.text: Popular pro

definitions.meaning: liked and approved of, as in being well regarded
pro means supporting, as in for a proposal

explanation.definitionFit: A popular figure is well liked, and one who is pro something supports it.

clue.text: Aim for goal

definitions.meaning: an aim, the purpose of an undertaking
a goal, the end one strives for

explanation.definitionFit: The purpose or objective of an action is its aim or its target end.

clue.text: Funny man in a suit

parts.note: read as a comedian in formal wear, but it is the jester card found in a pack of playing cards

explanation.surface: A comedian in a business suit.
explanation.definitionFit: The joker is a playing card showing a jester, and also a person who makes jokes.

clue.text: Keep on the beach: it will be soon liquidated

definitions.text: Keep on the beach: it will be soon liquidated

parts.words: Keep on the beach: it will be soon liquidated
parts.note: a keep is a castle stronghold built of beach material that the incoming tide will wash away

explanation.surface: Stay on the shore: the business will soon be wound up.
explanation.definitionFit: Children build these on the shore, and the rising tide soon dissolves them.

clue.text: Bringer of life and love?

parts.note: refers to the mouth-to-mouth rescue technique and to a romantic gesture

explanation.surface: Something that gives life and love.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase of life names resuscitation, and lovers exchange one as a sign of affection.

clue.text: Such a speech may be a tonic

definitions.meaning: the main address at a conference sets its theme
in music the tonic is the first note of the scale, the one a key is named for

explanation.definitionFit: A conference's principal address and the musical tonic share this name.

clue.text: Day hire arranged for US rural excursion

indicators.note: arranged says the letters of the two words are put in a different order

explanation.surface: Hiring for a day is organised for a country outing in America.
explanation.definitionFit: In America a ride in a farm wagon of hay is a country pleasure trip.
